description: Small, healthy schedule: identical activities in both revisions, one with a small progress bump, none behind. Control fixture for 'nothing is wrong' -- Nova should report a clean Green result, not manufacture a delay or a PONR entry out of nothing.
notes: behind_schedule_count==0 and point_of_no_return_count==0 are the load-bearing assertions -- this fixture exists so a matching/status regression that starts flagging healthy activities as behind has something to fail against.
